data.name: Jeriel
data.gender_notes: Jeriel is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew words ‘Yah’ (God) and ‘Ru’ah’ (mountain). Jeriel is a strong, divine name, reminding us of God’s power and presence. The name Jeriel carries the meaning “God's Mountain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Jeriel usually hope their child will grow to embody god's mountain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the strength and security found in God.
data.etymology: Jeriel belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Mountain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jeriel total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: Jeriel is a unique name with ancient origins. It carries the rich history of the Hebrew language and cultural influences. Its connection to the Hebrew Bible and Jewish heritage adds depth and resonance to the name.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jeriel holds deep spiritual meaning. By translating to ‘God of the Mountain’, this name acknowledges the might and power of the Lord, reminding us of His presence in our lives and the strength He provides when we face challenges. It is a name that inspires awe, devotion, and trust in the divine power of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jeriel, meaning "God's light" or "God's shining one," symbolizes the inner illumination and divine guidance received from the grace of God. This name evokes the image of a beacon shining in the darkness, guiding the way for those seeking spiritual enlightenment.
